description: 原子力災害発生時における避難先候補施設 [nuclear facilities and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 大分県. 万が一、原子力災害が発生し、避難候補施設を事前に取りまとめており、候補施設の名称や連絡先、面積や保有設備等について掲載しています。. Coverage: 大分県. The portal files it under the publisher 大分県. Its tags are 避難, 防災. It offers 2 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2026-05-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
